verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official CockroachDB SDK. The GitHub README says to use 'any available PostgreSQL client drivers' over the wire protocol, which means third-party Postgres drivers rather than first-party SDKs. The ccloud CLI, the MCP server and quickstart sample code are adjacent features from other stories and earn no credit here; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
